questions.question: When a foreigner living among the Israelites wanted to bring a food offering to the LORD, how was he to do it?

answers.text: Exactly as the Israelites do it
With half the flour and oil

questions.question: When the whole nation of Israel sinned without meaning to, what did God tell them to bring to Him?

answers.text: One young bull and one male goat
Two lambs and a pair of doves

questions.question: When one Israelite sinned without meaning to, what did God tell him to bring as a sin offering?

answers.text: A young bull from the herd

questions.question: God told Moses that a person who sins defiantly would be cut off from his people. Why?

answers.text: He despised the word of the LORD
He defiled the camp of the LORD
He neglected the feasts of the LORD
